abstract: Maintains construction mobilization scheduling and craft workforce staffing allocations
system_message:
You are the Project controls director (CTRL), responsible for maintaining construction mobilization scheduling and craft workforce staffing allocations, as well as tracking balance-of-system skid pre-assembly metrics across candidate EPC contractor consortiums.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Balance-of-system skid pre-assembly（MOD）
information_points.content:
CTRL-MOD-9IW：The offsite modularization progress audit for inverter power skid packages shows that TerraWatt Energy Partners achieves a skid pre-assembly completion share of 60% of total balance-of-system skids.
CTRL-MOD-JFD：The offsite modularization progress audit records a skid pre-assembly completion share of 80% for Vanguard Grid Infrastructure, reflecting factory pre-assembled inverter skids relative to total balance-of-system skids for inverter power skid packages.
CTRL-MOD-ITW：Based on the offsite modularization progress audit of inverter power skid packages, Apex CleanPower Solutions exhibits a skid pre-assembly completion share of 40%, measured as factory pre-assembled inverter skids as a percentage of total balance-of-system skids.

information_points.title: Maintains construction mobilization scheduling and craft workforce staffing allocations（PROJ）
information_points.content:
CTRL-PROJ-58T：For Vanguard Grid Infrastructure, the staffing mobilization plan indicates an allocated site construction craft workforce of 520 persons dedicated as full-time equivalent journeymen and apprentices across peak civil, structural, and electrical installation phases.
CTRL-PROJ-HU0：TerraWatt Energy Partners has an allocated site construction craft workforce of 450 persons in full-time equivalent journeyman and apprentice positions dedicated to the project during peak civil, structural, and electrical installation phases.
CTRL-PROJ-O3F：According to the staffing mobilization plan for peak civil, structural, and electrical installation phases, Apex CleanPower Solutions has an allocated site construction craft workforce of 600 persons, representing full-time equivalent dedicated journeyman and apprentice craft field workforce assigned to the project.
